portal_information_architecture.site_strategy: Use one governed Power Pages site for the external client portal and scope all project visibility through explicit dashboard-owned access grants.

page_map.title: Project Overview
page_map.purpose: Show the client-safe project summary, due dates, open required items, and the primary next action.
page_map.security_rule: Visible only when the signed-in external identity has an active organization or job-level grant for the linked dashboard project.

page_map.title: Required Items
page_map.purpose: List every required item with due dates, completion state, upload availability, and latest submission state.
page_map.security_rule: Visible only for the scoped project; hidden internal fields and reviewer notes must never render here.

page_map.title: Upload Documents
page_map.purpose: Provide the secure upload path for a project or required item using the governed Phase 5 request-link mapping.
page_map.security_rule: Show only upload destinations mapped to the signed-in client scope; never expose browse access to the underlying library.

page_map.title: Submission History
page_map.purpose: Let the client confirm what has been uploaded and how the submission is currently being handled.
page_map.security_rule: Display only client-safe submission metadata and statuses tied to the scoped project.

page_map.title: Help And Contact
page_map.purpose: Tell clients how to get help, what the response expectations are, and how upload or access issues are handled.
page_map.security_rule: General help content is available after sign-in; it must never reveal internal teams, escalation channels, or hidden record details.

authentication_model.invitation_rule: Every external user must be invited through an app-owned access grant before they can sign in to Power Pages.
authentication_model.identity_binding_rule: Bind portal access to the explicit external email on the access grant and store the resulting subject/contact references back in the dashboard contract.
authentication_model.mfa_rule: Require Entra External ID MFA for every portal sign-in in production and pilot environments.
authentication_model.session_rule: Keep external sessions short-lived and revoke access by disabling or revoking the underlying dashboard grant.
authentication_model.least_privilege_rule: Grant only the minimum web roles needed for the scoped organization or project.

scoping_rules.organization_scope_rule: Organization-scoped grants can view only projects and required items tied to that organization.
scoping_rules.project_scope_rule: Job-scoped grants can view only the one linked dashboard project and its portal-safe children.
scoping_rules.upload_scope_rule: Upload actions must resolve through the mapped request-link for the current project or required item and must never expose unrelated destinations.
scoping_rules.hidden_internal_data_rule: Internal notes, reviewer commentary, staffing details, and operational-only statuses remain hidden unless a future shareable-content layer explicitly marks them client-safe.
scoping_rules.shareable_content_rule: Only curated project summary, due dates, required items, client-safe submission history, and approved help content may appear in the portal.
scoping_rules.revocation_rule: Revoking or disabling the grant removes access immediately without changing dashboard record ownership or workflow history.

data_integration.dashboard_source_of_truth_rule: The dashboard remains authoritative for project state, required-item status, reviewer decisions, and approvals.
data_integration.portal_mirror_rule: Power Pages displays a portal-safe mirror built from the dashboard and the existing intake submission contract.
data_integration.upload_handling_rule: Uploads continue through the Phase 5 secure intake mappings so receipt, review, and reminders stay unified.
data_integration.dashboard_id_traceability_rule: Every portal grant, project link, upload, and confirmation must store or resolve the canonical dashboard ids.
data_integration.approval_status_rule: Portal history can show receipt and review state, but only the dashboard can mark an item complete or approved.

support_model.help_page_rule: The help page must route clients to the governed support mailbox and reference only client-safe instructions.
support_model.escalation_rule: Portal support incidents escalate through the existing dashboard and Microsoft alerting layers, not through ad hoc site-owner intervention.
support_model.maintenance_rule: Portal content, access grants, project links, and upload mappings must be reviewed together before each release or tenant change.
support_model.audit_rule: Every access grant change, project link update, and client-facing portal event must remain traceable to dashboard ids.

execution_order.title: Validate Phase 1 through Phase 6 baselines and confirm secure intake plus mail automation are healthy.
execution_order.rollback: Do not enable the Phase 7 portal flag until all prerequisite diagnostics are green.

execution_order.title: Create the governed Power Pages site, web roles, and Entra External ID identity provider configuration for the pilot environment.
execution_order.rollback: Disable external sign-in and remove site visibility before widening access.

execution_order.title: Create dashboard-owned access grants and project links for pilot organizations and projects.
execution_order.rollback: Disable or revoke the grants and archive the project links.

execution_order.title: Validate scoped project visibility, required-item history, secure upload routing, and help-mailbox support flow.
execution_order.rollback: Pause portal rollout and keep clients on the existing Phase 5 request-link workflow.

execution_order.title: Turn on the portal for the pilot cohort only after traceability, revocation, and upload review paths all pass validation.
execution_order.rollback: Disable MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_PORTAL_ENABLED and revoke pilot grants.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Create or validate the Power Pages site and connect it to the governed Power Platform environment.
Configure Entra External ID sign-in, invitation flows, and MFA enforcement for the portal site.
Create the minimal portal web roles that align with the dashboard grant model and confirm they do not expose internal tables or pages.
manual_admin_checklist.portal: Power Pages / Power Platform Admin Center

manual_admin_checklist.step: Set MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_PORTAL_SITE_URL, MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_PORTAL_AUTH_PROVIDER, and MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_PORTAL_DEFAULT_HELP_MAILBOX_KEY for the target environment.
Create pilot access grants and portal project links, then review /api/admin/system/microsoft-client-portal before inviting external users.

validation_checklist: External users can sign in only through Entra External ID and only after a matching active dashboard grant exists.
Organization-scoped users cannot see projects outside their organization, and job-scoped users cannot see sibling projects.
Required-item status and submission history resolve from existing dashboard and intake data with dashboard ids intact.
Upload actions route to the correct Phase 5 secure intake mapping and never expose unrelated files or folders.
Revoking a grant removes portal access without changing internal workflow ownership or submission audit history.
rollback_principles: Disable MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_PORTAL_ENABLED before changing portal access rules in a live environment.
Revoke or disable grants instead of widening Power Pages table permissions when access drift is suspected.
Keep help and upload flows operational even when project links are paused so support can triage impacted clients.
Never copy internal operational notes into portal content as a workaround for missing shareable fields.
